summary: @servicetitan/error-boundary ships preinstall dropper that runs a 727KB obfuscated payload under a downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares itself as a React error-boundary component but registers a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and uses `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run a sibling file, math_init.js, that is not among the declared `files` (`dist`, `src`). math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line script wrapped in classic string-array-shuffle obfuscation (a `WV8StW` rotator over a large numeric/token array with a `hc1jfK9` Base85-style decoder) that hides its actual behavior from static inspection. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute this bundle, evading Node-only tooling. The presence of a preinstall dropper, an alternate-runtime fetch, and a large obfuscated payload is entirely disjoint from the advertised React error-boundary purpose and is inconsistent with prior releases of the ServiceTitan uikit scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
